Hey <@U0A6088AMM3>,

There is no fix frequency to set for CDC. It primarily depends on the following factors:
• Freshness required in your destination table.
• Change logs accumulation (if not your read disk might start filling up).

text:
hey <@U0A6088AMM3> ,
OLake CDC requires `binlog_row_metadata = FULL` . OLake relies on binary log events being self-describing to column metadata directly from row events, which requires `binlog_row_metadata = FULL`.
for more info:
<https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/9.7/en/replication-options-binary-log.html#sysvar_binlog_row_metadata|dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/…/replication-options-binary-log.html#…>
